title: 第9章软饭硬吃冰山女教皇喜提圣女小师妹第10章 怨龙毒武魂进化就要师哥嘛
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆

;;
“没……没有。”
“小人不敢，是……是四供奉和圣子大人这么说的。”
龙涛惊的面色惨白，身躯颤抖，低着头根本不敢去看那双狭长凤眸。
“喂，抬起头，别那么没出息，刚才还说自己大彻大悟了。”
龙涛肩膀冷不丁被拍了一下，耳畔传来调侃声音，扭头赫然看见阳光帅气的面孔，不是走过来的洛凡尘还能是谁？
“别乱说话，快向教皇陛下行礼。”
龙涛快吓哭了。
他能不害怕么，魂武大陆有句话一直广为流传，宁犯阎罗王，别惹女教皇，可见帝薇央流传在外的威名多么恐怖。
“四供奉，呵。”帝薇央闻言后凤眸透出一抹冷芒，淡声道：“旧时代的残党，如何能评判新时代的天骄？”
龙涛懵了，他本以为刚才说让洛凡尘以后争取打供奉、圣子狗脸，被女教皇听见肯定完犊子了。
结果对方似乎根本没在意，对供奉不屑，反倒是好像……很看好洛凡尘？
龙涛心神一动，不对，刚才那句话透露出的意思已经不仅仅是看好那么简单了。
洛凡尘这边不卑不亢，正视女教皇那张不怒自威的绝世容颜，暗暗心惊。
好一个神殿女教皇。
姿色绝伦不说，更是霸气侧漏，就连最少九十五级以上的供奉都入不了她的法眼，沦落为旧时代残党。
“嘿，你不怕我老师嘛？”妙龄少女紫色马尾晃动，惊奇问道。
洛凡尘反问：“为什么要怕？”
少女樱唇微张，隐约能看见一对儿可爱虎牙，对方这一问，直接把她整不会了。
难道不应该怕么？

要知道许多位高权重之人，在教皇老师的强势气场下，也如面前这小执事和周围村民一般，像是老鼠见了猫，心神不安，不敢抬头。
此时，不止是圣女好奇，就连女教皇也略感诧异。
身居高位多年，再加上恐怖的实力，敢与她对视的人寥寥无几，这青年着实与众不同。
而且从不在意他人长相，脸盲的女教皇，竟然隐隐觉得面前这青年帅的过于逆天，似是散发着某种特殊魅力。
洛凡尘嘴角翘起，溢出一抹帅气弧度：“行得端，站得正，做事无愧于心，纵然女教皇亲临，又何惧之有？”
紫发圣女见到那笑容略微失神，想着世间怎会有如此好看的男人，桃唇开合。
“你就不怕老师对你动手？”
洛凡尘摊手笑道：
“怕也是死，不怕也是死，那为什么要怕呢？”
“而且我觉得两位若是想加害我，没必要说这么多，直接动手就好了啊。”
龙涛在旁边听的手心都捏了一把冷汗，要死了，这些话简直以下犯上，胆大包天，不要命了嘛。
大兄弟，不，祖宗！您是真勇，女教皇也一样硬刚，不给面子的么？
咱就算不当舔狗，说两句恭维的好话也成啊，大可不必这么硬气，把对方的好感作没了就是等死啊。
紫发圣女檀口微张，扭头朝着身旁冷艳女教皇惊奇道：“老师，你说的没错，这家伙真的好特别，跟神殿其他男人不一样。”
女教皇清冷薄唇紧闭，并未回应，但眼神多了几分赞许之色。
她平生最不喜欢的便是奴颜媚骨，趋炎附势之人，洛凡尘这等宁折不弯的态度，深得她的心意。
思索后，启唇道：
“吾，光明神殿第十三代女教皇，帝薇央，你可愿拜我为师。”

"No...no."
"I don't dare, I don't dare, it's...it was Si Zangfang and Lord Shengzi who said so."
Long Tao's face turned pale with shock, his body was trembling, and he lowered his head and did not dare to look at those narrow phoenix eyes.
"Hey, raise your head, don't be so hopeless. Just now you said you had a great enlightenment."
Long Tao was suddenly tapped on the shoulder, and a teasing voice came from his ears. He turned around and saw the handsome face of Sunshine. Who else could it be if it wasn't Luo Fanchen who was walking over?
"Stop talking nonsense and salute His Majesty the Pope quickly."
Long Tao was scared to tears.
How can he not be afraid? There is a saying that has been widely circulated in Hunwu Continent, it is better to offend King Yama than the female pope. This shows how terrifying Di Weiyang's reputation is.
"Four offerings, ha." After hearing this, Di Weiyang's phoenix eyes showed a cold light, and she said quietly: "How can the remnants of the old era judge the genius of the new era?"
Long Tao was confused. He had thought that he had just told Luo Fanchen to try to beat up the worshiper and the Holy Son in the future, but if the female pope heard about it, he would definitely be doomed.
As a result, the other party didn't seem to care at all and was disdainful of the offering. Instead, he seemed to be... very optimistic about Luo Fanchen?
Long Tao's mind moved. No, the meaning revealed in those words just now was not just as simple as being optimistic.
Luo Fanchen, who was neither humble nor arrogant, was secretly frightened when he looked at the female pope's unruffled and peerless face.
What a temple female pope.
Not only is she stunningly beautiful, she is also very domineering. Even those who are at least level ninety-five cannot catch her eye, and she is reduced to a remnant of the old era.
"Hey, aren't you afraid of my teacher?" the young girl asked in surprise, her purple ponytail swaying.
Luo Fanchen asked, "Why are you afraid?"
The girl's lips were slightly open, and a pair of cute tiger teeth could be vaguely seen. The other party's question immediately put her off guard.
Shouldn't we be afraid?
You must know that many high-ranking people, under the strong aura of Teacher Pope, are like the little deacon and the surrounding villagers, like a mouse seeing a cat, uneasy and afraid to raise its head.
At this time, not only the saint was curious, but even the female pope was slightly surprised.
Having held a high position for many years, coupled with her terrifying strength, there were only a few people who dared to look at her. This young man was really different.
Moreover, the blind female pope, who never cared about other people's looks, felt that the young man in front of her was extremely handsome and seemed to exude some kind of special charm.
The corner of Luo Fanchen's mouth turned up, revealing a handsome arc: "Behave properly, stand upright, and do things with no regrets. Even if the female pope comes in person, why should you be afraid?"
The purple-haired saint was slightly distracted when she saw that smile, thinking how could there be such a good-looking man in the world, her peach lips opened and closed.
"Aren't you afraid that the teacher will do something to you?"
Luo Fanchen spread his hands and smiled:
"Being afraid is also death, not being afraid is also death, so why be afraid?"
"And I feel that if you two want to harm me, there is no need to say so much, you can just do it directly."
Long Tao's palms were sweating as he listened. He felt like he was about to die. These words were so outrageous. He was so audacious that he would risk his life.
Big brother, no, ancestor! Are you really brave? The female pope is just as tough. Don't you want to give her face?
Even if we don't lick the dog, we can just say a few compliments. There is no need to be so tough. If you lose the other person's favor, you will be waiting for death.
The purple-haired saint opened her mouth slightly, turned to the cold female pope beside her and said in surprise: "Teacher, you are right, this guy is really special, he is different from other men in the temple."
The female pope closed her cold and thin lips tightly and did not respond, but her eyes were a little more approving.
What she disliked most in her life was people who were servile and slavish. Luo Fanchen's attitude of being willing to bend rather than bend won her heart.
After thinking about it, he opened his lips and said:
"I, Di Weiyang, the thirteenth generation female pope of the Temple of Light, are you willing to worship me as your teacher."
